title: Z-Image Turbo: picture from words
does: A photo-real or illustrated picture from one plain sentence. Fast: a few seconds each on a big GPU, about 12 GB of VRAM.

prompt.help: what the picture shows, in plain sentences

seed.help: same seed and settings give the same result

tips: Describe the subject, what it does, the setting, the light and the camera. Concrete words beat quality words like 8k or masterpiece.
Put any text that must appear in the picture in quotes.
